svg.title: Request path of a query and an update
svg.desc: A SPARQL query passes through six steps: the HTTP layer takes an operation permit, the query is parsed, the local-only policy rejects network operations, property functions are replaced by value tables, the query runs on the Oxigraph store, and results are serialized. An update takes the mutation lock, rejects property functions and runs on the store.
svg.text: Query: POST /query
HTTP layer
takes one of 4 permits, or answers 503
crates/rdf-server: work() runs the job on a blocking thread
Parse
spargebra turns the text into algebra
syntax errors stop here, with a position
Local-only policy
SERVICE and LOAD are refused
federation is a plugin, not the core engine
Property functions
each call runs once; its rows become
a VALUES table joined into the pattern
checked first with no side effects, then run
limits: 64 calls, 10,000 rows, 8 MiB
Execute on Oxigraph
the evaluator picks an index per pattern
see Storage for which column family answers what
Serialize
format chosen by the Accept header
JSON, XML or CSV for results; Turtle for graphs; 406 if none fits
Update: POST /update
permit, then parse; property functions are refused inside updates; the dataset's mutation lock is taken; the update runs on the store.
Plugin operations (POST /api/plugins/<plugin>/operations/<op>) take a permit too, then run the plugin, then any refresh rules.
